justifications.fit: the report cites exact paths and lines in the surrounding watch.py/telemetry_index.py idiom and the recommended change names the two files it belongs in; the four naming checks over the changed paths return no forbidden plan, version or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_ambix/agent/watch.py:1056 watch_document is profiled against the index and the report attributes the 102.9 s wall to named calls (telemetry_index.py:1526 rows 49.2 s, :1360 time_weighted_mean 32.1 s, :1432 partitioned_total 16.9 s) and 2.90 GiB peak RSS, matching the goal of finding where the command spends its time and memory.
justifications.scope_discipline: the reviewed worktree sits at d0cdc32f with an empty status digest, every artefact named in changed_paths is inside the one declared write path reports/imas-ambix/0c4316b2-.../srw-watch-read-cost-profile, and the live index was opened only mode=ro for the backup copy so nothing outside the fence was written.
